name: What are the benefits of choosing a flexible listing agreement?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing a flexible listing agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A key benefit is the potential to save on commission costs if you find the buyer yourself, or if you decide to work with an agent who agrees to this structure. It also offers more control over the selling process. This type of agreement can be beneficial for sellers who have a specific buyer in mind or who are confident in their ability to market their property independently, potentially reducing overall selling expenses. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can help you weigh these benefits against the potential trade-offs, such as reduced agent motivation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include potential commission savings if you find your own buyer and more control over the selling process.
